lab.title: Grid World concept lab
lab.description: Choose an action and watch the state, transition, reward, and return update together.
lab.ready: Ready. Choose an action or use the arrow keys.
lab.failed: The experiment could not start. The chapter text remains available.
lab.commandRejected: The command was rejected by the model.

errors.grid_size: Grid sides must stay within the supported range.
errors.state_out_of_bounds: A configured state is outside the grid.
errors.start_equals_goal: Start and goal must be different states.
errors.hazard_overlap: A hazard cannot overlap the start or goal.
errors.probability_range: Probabilities and the discount factor must be finite values from 0 to 1.
errors.reward_magnitude: A reward is too large to keep the bounded return finite.
errors.unknown_goal_mode: The selected goal behavior is not supported.
errors.episode_finished: The episode has already finished; reset before stepping again.
errors.step_limit_reached: The 100-step observation limit has been reached.
errors.unknown_action: The requested action is not supported.
errors.policy_not_normalized: Policy probabilities must sum to one.
errors.policy_length: The policy must contain exactly five action probabilities.
errors.invalid_seed: Enter a hexadecimal seed, for example 5eed.
errors.worker_error: The experiment worker reported an unexpected error.

lab.episodeComplete: Goal reached. This episode is complete; reset to try another path.
lab.stepLimit: The 100-step observation limit was reached. Reset to start a new trace.
lab.boundary: The action met the boundary, so the state did not change.
lab.moved: Moved from s{from} to s{to}; reward {reward}.
lab.transitionPanelBody: Rust enumerates every possible actual action and its probability from the current state.
lab.transitionWindHint: First choose a movement action and inspect its no-wind baseline row above: the requested action has one deterministic outcome. Then enable wind to reveal and compare the stochastic transition row. With seed 5eed, try right-right-down-down after reset and inspect the realised right-right-down-left trace.
lab.policyPanelBody: Edit π(a|s) for the current state. A valid row is non-negative and sums to one.
lab.policyNeedsNormalization: Normalize the row before sampling an action.
lab.rewardPanelBody: Edit immediate feedback for four event types, then apply to start a comparable episode.
lab.rewardApplyHint: Changing a reward starts a new episode so returns remain comparable.
lab.returnPanelBody: Each reward contributes γ^t rₜ₊₁ to the discounted return. The trajectory table exposes every term.
lab.episodePanelBody: Use the same path while changing only what reaching the diamond means.
lab.episodeTerminal: The terminal rule fired; another action is rejected until reset.
lab.episodeAbsorbing: The model remains at the goal and emits zero on later steps.
lab.episodeContinuing: The goal gives feedback but does not stop interaction.
lab.markovPanelBody: Suppose wind has a hidden calm or gusty regime. The visible cell alone then predicts two different next-step distributions.
lab.sameVisibleState: Visible state in both contexts: s{state}
lab.calmContext: Calm: requested right remains right with probability 1.
lab.windContext: Gusty: requested right remains right with probability {probability}.
lab.markovFails: Cell position alone is not Markov when the wind regime affects the next transition but is hidden.
lab.markovRestored: Use the augmented state (cell, wind regime); the current state now contains the predictive information.
lab.increaseWind: First note that the calm and gusty predictions match while wind is off. Then enable wind to expose the hidden-context difference. With seed 5eed, request right-right-down-down after reset and compare the realised right-right-down-left trace.
lab.auditPanelBody: These checks are computed from the live, language-neutral experiment state.
lab.auditTransition: Every transition row sums to one
lab.auditPolicy: Policy row is a probability distribution
lab.auditSpecialStates: Start, goal, and hazards do not overlap
lab.keyboard: Keyboard: arrow keys move; Space stays.
